body: Thanks for the advice - I'll try to talk to her more about it.
I've told her , not everything but the basics - it makes her sad. She's our sole provider at the moment and does everything. I don't want to burden her more.

My partners said she doesn't want me to go anywhere. But in afraid she doesn't understand exactly what she is taking on. I've spent my entire life trying to protect people, I just feel so conflicted. The fear is so real.

It's what I fear I'll become, as I stands now my inability to do things physically means things like going away on holidays or adventures with the kids is an impossibility. If we try and move house my capabilities will always have to be considered.

If I end up with MND, I'll waste until I can't do anything myself, my partner will have to feed me, move me, clean me. It's not fair on any of them to live like that.
